stories.title: Murder accused says he had 'no excuse' for fatal punch
stories.summary: Billy Allison denies murdering Matthew O'Gara at the Ricco and Loren bar in Lichfield.

stories.title: Pair deny fake passport plot for murder suspect
stories.summary: Two men deny knowingly helping a murder suspect obtain a fake passport, court hears.

stories.title: Touring theatre show warns children against vaping
stories.summary: Hooked, commissioned by Walsall Council Public Health, is touring up to 25 secondary schools.

stories.title: Inquest opens into 74th patient of disgraced surgeon
stories.summary: The inquest team have not yet traced the family of Olive Corbett, who died aged 93 in 2006.

stories.title: ‘We can finally plan our future': Joy as £2.2bn Ladywood scheme axed
stories.summary: George Smith, of campaigners Ladywood Unite, says residents are "absolutely delighted" by the news.

stories.title: Baby thriving after 3D-printed model used to save her heart
stories.summary: A 3D printed model of Penny's heart was used to help her parents and medics see what was needed.

stories.title: Man accused of fatal dancefloor punch 'really sorry'
stories.summary: Billy Allison denies murdering Matthew O'Gara but has pleaded guilty to manslaughter.

stories.title: Thieves steal from town's Remembrance display
stories.summary: Two metal silhouettes depicting soldiers are stolen from a roundabout in Halesowen.

stories.title: Woman arrested after Ofsted shuts nursery over child safety fears
stories.summary: A woman has been cautioned as Wonderland Day Nursery has its license suspended.

stories.title: Poundland crisis 'could see all businesses suffer'
stories.summary: Poundland has filed a notice of intention to appoint administrators.

stories.title: Car rammed before men launch machete attack
stories.summary: Police said men armed with machetes attacked the victim's vehicle before fleeing and eventually being stopped on the M40.

stories.title: Woman becomes first female standard bearer in charity's history
stories.summary: The honour comes for Simy Martin after the charity helped rebuild confidence after she became blind.
